Proof of Mythology (No.2) Memorial Album Item

How to obtain: Defeat "???" / Temple Guardian bosses in the Temple of Poseidon Endless Dungeon (only accessible from Acropolis of Atlantis if Atlantis is present on Maris server).

Bosses beginning from B30 and higher floors can drop this. Hidden passage black "aura" bosses can also drop it a bit more commonly; Aether Attribute hidden passage bosses may drop it as well, though they are extremely difficult enemies compared to the others.

IMPORTANT: you must have open slots in your inventory to receive the item drop for MA!

Drop rate: somewhat rare

Use: Equip as Land Battle Item - when used, it will fill the Tech Gauge (sword gauge at the top of your screen while in battle) 1-2 levels, allowing access to higher ranked techs much sooner. The only drawback is that Tech Gauge caps at Rank 5, making continued use of this item unnecessary -- but being able to use high level techs quicker is helpful in certain PvE/PVP battles.
